reasoning_content:
I see multiple issues:

1. AssetHealthService - config issue with quarantinePath - this is what's causing the current crash
2. Trying to load dist/config/firebase.js but we're running from tsx (source) - that's fine
3. PM2 calling "run tsx" which doesn't exist - need to use "tsx" command differently

Let me fix the pm2 startup command properly:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'ENDOFSCRIPT'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Stop and restart with proper command
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 stop areloria 2>&1")
print("Stop:", stdout.read().decode())

# Start directly with node and tsx
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && SUPABASE_URL=x SUPABASE_ANON_KEY=x pm2 start npx --name areloria -- tsx src/index.ts 2>&1")
print("Start:", stdout.read().decode())

# Wait
import time
time.sleep(8)

# Check
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 status 2>&1")
print("\nStatus:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
ENDOFSCRIPT
